source_note: Facts cross-checked against the app's question bank and standard references.

bullets.en: AB positive = universal recipient; O negative = universal donor.
bullets.ne: AB positive = सर्वग्राही (universal recipient); O negative = सर्वदाता (universal donor)।

bullets.en: Normal vitals: BP 120/80 mmHg; pulse 60–100/min; body temperature 37°C (98.6°F).
bullets.ne: सामान्य मान: रक्तचाप 120/80 mmHg; नाडी 60–100/मिनेट; शरीरको तापक्रम 37°C (98.6°F)।

bullets.en: Vitamin A → night blindness; C → scurvy; D → rickets; K → blood clotting; B1 → beriberi.
bullets.ne: भिटामिन A → रतन्धो; C → स्कर्भी; D → रिकेट्स; K → रगत जम्ने; B1 → बेरीबेरी।

bullets.en: Deworming: albendazole for children aged 12 months–5 years, every 6 months (with vitamin A).
bullets.ne: जुकाको औषधि: 12 महिना–5 वर्षका बालबालिकालाई अल्बेन्डाजोल, हरेक 6 महिनामा (भिटामिन A सहित)।

bullets.en: BCG vaccine at birth protects against TB; ORS (Jeevan Jal) treats dehydration from diarrhoea.
bullets.ne: जन्मिँदा BCG खोप (क्षयरोगविरुद्ध); झाडापखालाको निर्जलीकरणमा ORS (जीवनजल)।

bullets.en: FCHV = Female Community Health Volunteer — Nepal's grassroots health workers.
bullets.ne: FCHV = महिला सामुदायिक स्वास्थ्य स्वयंसेविका — नेपालका गाउँस्तरीय स्वास्थ्यकर्मी।

bullets.en: Tilganga Institute of Ophthalmology: famous for low-cost cataract surgery and intraocular lens production.
bullets.ne: तिलगंगा आँखा प्रतिष्ठान: सस्तो मोतियाबिन्दु शल्यक्रिया र लेन्स उत्पादनका लागि प्रसिद्ध।

bullets.en: Parkinson's disease: tremor, rigidity, bradykinesia (slow movement), postural instability.
bullets.ne: पार्किन्सन्स रोग: काम्ने, जडता, ढिलो चाल, सन्तुलन गुम्ने।

bullets.en: Diabetes = high blood sugar (an insulin problem); hypertension = high blood pressure.
bullets.ne: मधुमेह = रगतमा चिनी बढी (इन्सुलिन समस्या); उच्च रक्तचाप = hypertension।

bullets.en: Anaemia = low haemoglobin (iron deficiency); goitre = iodine deficiency.
bullets.ne: रक्तअल्पता = हेमोग्लोबिन कम (आइरन कमी); गलगाँड = आयोडिन कमी।

bullets.en: First aid for sprains: RICE — Rest, Ice, Compression, Elevation.
bullets.ne: मर्केको प्राथमिक उपचार: RICE — आराम, बरफ, कसिलो बाँध्ने, उचाइमा राख्ने।

bullets.en: HIV spreads through blood, unprotected sex and mother-to-child — NOT by touch or sharing food.
bullets.ne: HIV रगत, असुरक्षित यौन र आमा–शिशुबाट सर्छ — छोएर वा खाना बाँडेर सर्दैन।
